check_subjective.question: Subjective Requirement Check
check_subjective.description: Does the good fail to match the quantity, quality, packaging, or description explicitly agreed upon in the contract or sales receipt?

check_objective.question: Objective Requirement Check
check_objective.description: Does the product fail normal expectations for fitness for standard purpose, durability, safety, or sample/model comparison?

check_public_statements.question: Advertising & Public Statements
check_public_statements.description: Does the product fail to conform to specific claims made in marketing, on packaging, or in public statements by the seller or producer?

check_explicit_agreement.question: Explicit Pre-Sale Fault Disclaimer
check_explicit_agreement.description: Was the consumer explicitly informed of this specific fault prior to purchase and did they explicitly accept it?

check_assembly.question: Assembly & Installation Check
check_assembly.description: Was the defect caused by incorrect installation performed by the seller, or by faulty assembly instructions in the manual?

check_assembly_after_objective_fault.question: Assembly & Installation Check
check_assembly_after_objective_fault.description: Was the fault also exacerbated by incorrect installation or faulty manual instructions?

check_timeframe_objective.question: Timeframe & Presumption Period
check_timeframe_objective.description: How many months have passed since the product was delivered to the consumer?
